title: 6 November 1963: Live: ABC Cinema, Northampton
content:
The fifth stop on The Beatles’ Autumn Tour of England and Ireland in 1963 took them to the ABC Theatre in Northampton.

They performed 10 songs: ‘I Saw Her Standing There’, ‘From Me To You’, ‘All My Loving’, ‘You Really Got A Hold On Me’, ‘Roll Over Beethoven’, ‘Boys’, ‘Till There Was You’, ‘She Loves You’, ‘Money (That’s What I Want)’ and ‘Twist And Shout’.

This was The Beatles’ second and final concert appearance in Northampton. They had previously performed at the ABC Cinema on 27 March 1963.
